games.codexInterpretation: The AI attacked with a large army, including Memnarch. Memnarch’s artifact-count draw trigger resolved before combat damage, and the original Game Outcome explicitly says Jace lost trying to draw from an empty library (line 1956). Ghalta was the surviving winner; combat defeat was not the recorded cause of Jace’s elimination. A human should check remaining library versus artifact count before attacking with Memnarch. Dreadhorde was cast much later in this game, so its presence is not an explanation for the self-decking loss.

games.codexInterpretation: Dreadhorde was cast at line 142. An earlier Army grew to 3 power, attacked into Craterhoof and died (lines 452–459). A replacement Army (417) was exiled adjacent to Jace’s -3 at lines 582–584; Overlord’s entry trigger followed (585–586), a strong clue but not a confirmed reveal event in this ordinary log. The later board included more Armies/Insects and Jace won. This demonstrates the recurring-fodder role. The earlier attack is an AI decision to audit; the old KEEP_TOKENS rule protects only power<=2, and real Jace could instead use a grown Army as fodder.
